stories.subject: Top Dawg Entertainment / California Court of Appeal
stories.headline: TDE WINS A DOXXING APPEAL
stories.deck: A California appeals court said Top Dawg Entertainment’s press release was protected activity and reversed the trial court’s refusal to strike the doxxing claim. The underlying misconduct case continues.
stories.verification: The published California Court of Appeal opinion and Bloomberg Law independently confirm the anti-SLAPP reversal and that the underlying misconduct case remains separate.

stories.subject: Eminem / EZ Mil / MADARA
stories.headline: EMINEM & EZ MIL GO MADARA
stories.deck: The new single pairs Eminem and EZ Mil with Tokyo rapper Hideyoshi and Naruto voice actor Neil Kaplan. It is the pair’s third collaboration and turns an anime reference into a cross-Pacific rap event.
stories.verification: Apple Music lists the October 8 release and credits; Complex independently confirms the collaborators, concept, and third-collaboration context.

stories.subject: Trippie Redd / Southwest Ranches search warrant
stories.headline: TRIPPIE’S MANSION RAID LEADS TO ARREST
stories.deck: Police searched Trippie Redd’s Southwest Ranches home in a Miami-led investigation and arrested Braveone Jones on two attempted-murder counts. Trippie was not arrested in the raid; the case remains active.
stories.verification: CBS Miami and NBC 6 independently report the search and arrest; Complex confirms the Miami-led investigation and that Trippie was not the person arrested in the warrant service.

stories.subject: Trick Daddy / Trina / GTA VI Dirty South Classics
stories.headline: TRICK & TRINA TAKE THE AIRWAVES
stories.deck: Rockstar’s GTA VI music rollout names Trick Daddy and Trina as the voices of Dirty South Classics, a regional-rap station. Rockstar also confirmed the game’s first on-demand podcasts for driving or walking.
stories.verification: Rockstar’s official GTA VI music page names the station and hosts; TechRadar independently confirms the station preview and first-time in-game podcast feature.

stories.subject: Nintendo Switch 2 / GTA VI platform question
stories.headline: GTA VI ON SWITCH 2? NO ANSWER YET
stories.deck: Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard said any GTA VI Switch 2 decision belongs to Take-Two and Rockstar, with nothing to announce. The November launch remains confirmed for PS5 and Xbox Series.
stories.verification: Nintendo Everything and Nintendo Life independently quote Devon Pritchard’s Variety interview; both state that no Switch 2 release has been announced and the decision rests with Rockstar/Take-Two.

source_policy: At least two current reputable sources per story; five distinct stories; no stale or repeated topics from prior batches.
